combinations.magnitude: significant inhibition of mechanical hypersensitivity (P < 0.05 vs CCI saline) whereas each sub-effective dose alone had no significant effect
combinations.model: chronic constriction injury of sciatic nerve
combinations.evidence_quote: In the current study, cotreatment of CCI rats with a low, subeffective dose of choline (6 mg/kg) and parecoxib sodium (3 mg/kg) induced a significant pain inhibition, indicating that the two drugs may exert an additive or synergistic pain inhibitory effect.

combinations.magnitude: significant inhibition of heat hypersensitivity (P < 0.05 vs CCI saline) whereas each sub-effective dose alone was not effective
combinations.model: chronic constriction injury of sciatic nerve
combinations.evidence_quote: Compared with the saline-treated CCI rats, choline (6 mg/kg) and parecoxib (3 mg/kg) treatment resulted in a significant inhibition of both mechanical and heat hypersensitivities (P < 0.05, Fig. 3A-B).

combinations.evidence_quote: However, the levels of HMGB1 and NF-κBp65 were not significantly decreased in CCI rats after receiving single drug treatment with choline (6 mg/kg) or parecoxib (3 mg/kg).
